stem: A KPI improves only after failed units are removed from a denominator that originally included all eligible starts. How should the result be treated?
choices: Accept it because the percentage is higher.
It is not comparable until recalculated using the defined denominator and eligibility rule.
Use the new denominator for historical cycles without documentation.
Treat the single value as a confirmed trend.
rationale: KPI interpretation requires a stable definition; changing the eligible population after seeing results destroys comparability and can misstate performance.
